_about: Rules for translating the website (content/site/<lang>.json). Read by translators and by `python3 tools/site_i18n.py check`.

app_names._note: App names are the same in every store language (App Store / Google Play listings). Arabic names that appear inside English texts, e.g. «خزنة الضمانات», «كم مضى وكم بقي», stay in Arabic.

style: Warm, simple, friendly; short sentences; the reader is an ordinary phone user, not a technician.
Same meaning as the English: never add or drop facts, prices, numbers, dates or promises.
Keep every HTML tag exactly (<b>, <em>, <q>, <a href=…>); translate only the text between tags; never change an href.
Keep «…» quotes around button names as the English has them, or the language's normal quotation marks.
Use the formal-polite register that app stores use in that language (vous, Sie, usted, вы, Anda, आप, …).
Store button lines: translate like the official badges (e.g. FR «Télécharger dans l'App Store», DE «Laden im App Store») but keep «App Store» / «Google Play» / «YouTube».
Brand: «Q Apps» stays in Latin letters in every language except Arabic.
